diagnosis: The cart release endpoint invalidates active shopping cart reservation sessions using req.params.cartSessionId directly in the Redis store. It fails to verify that the target cart session belongs to the requesting client. An attacker can destroy competitors' or other shoppers' active cart sessions, freeing up scarce inventory during flash sales.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cart/sessions/cart_sess_buyer_49102/release HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.retail.internal:3300
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aattacker_cart_cookie
Accept: application/json
